reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Programme de renforcement de la prévention et de la prise en charge du VIH/SIDA et de la tuberculose en RCA - Central African Republic (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Central African Republic, TB/HIV, La Croix-Rouge française (CRF)This program has the following goals: Réduire le nombre de décès liés à la tuberculose de 2200 en 2015 à 902 en 2023 / Reduce the number of tuberculosis related deaths from 2,200 in 2015 to 902 in 2023. Les nouvelles infections du VIH sont réduites de 50% d'ici 2025 / The new HIV infections are reduced by 50% by 2025. Le taux de transmission du VIH de la mère à l'enfant passe de 12,43% en 2019 à moins de 7,48% en 2025 / Mother to Child HIV Transmission rate reduces from 12.43% in 2019 to a rate below 7.48% in 2025. The objectives of this program are: Atteindre au moins 15646 cas de cas de tuberculose toutes formes confondues notifiés en 2023 avec un taux de succès thérapeutique au moins à 90% / Reach at least 15,646 cases of all forms of Tuberculosis reported in 2023 with a treatment success rate of at least 90% cases. Augmenter en 2023 à 165 le nombre de malades mis sous traitement pour une tuberculose multi-résistante ou résistante à la rifampicine et atteindre un taux de succès thérapeutique d’au moins 90% / Increase in 2023 to 165 the number of patients undergoing treatment for multi-resistant or rifampicin-resistant Tuberculosis and achieve a therapeutic success rate of at least 90%. Renforcer la prise en charge des patients co-infectés tuberculose/VIH par le dépistage systématique de l’infection VIH chez 90% des malades tuberculeux notifiés, la mise sous traitement antirétroviral et le cotrimoxazole chez >95% des patients co-infectés tuberculose/VIH en 2023 / Strengthen care and treatment of TB/HIV coinfected patients by systematic screening for HIV infection in 90% of notified Tuberculosis patients, initiation of Antiretroviral Therapy and Cotrimoxazole in >95% of TB/HIV co-infected patients in 2023. Accroitre les financements pour la lutte contre la TB et améliorer les capacités de gestion du PNLT / Increase funding for the fight against TB and improve the management capacities of the National Program for the fight against TB. Améliorer la collaboration avec les communautés, les organisations de la société civile et humanitaires pour la prévention, le diagnostic et le suivi du traitement de la tuberculose (TB) / Improve collaboration with communities, civil society and humanitarian organizations for the prevention, diagnosis and monitoring of TB treatment. Surveillance suivi et évaluation et renforcer la recherche opérationnelle / Surveillance, monitoring and evaluation and strengthen operational research. D’ici 2025, 70% des populations clés (PS, HSH, Personnes privées de leur liberté) utilisent le paquet de services de prévention combinée / By 2025, 70% of key populations (FSW, MSM, Persons deprived of their liberty) are using the combined prevention service package. D’ici 2025, 95 % des femmes enceintes et allaitantes VIH+ reçoivent le traitement antirétroviral pour réduire le taux de transmission du VIH de la mère à l’enfant / By 2025, 95% of HIV positive pregnant and breastfeeding women receive antiretroviral therapy to reduce the rate of mother-to-child HIV transmission. D’ici 2025, 95% des patients éligibles au dépistage ciblé dans les Formations sanitaires sont dépistés / By 2025, 95% of patients eligible for targeted testing in health facilities are tested. D’ici 2025, 95% des PVVIH bénéficient d’une prise en charge de qualité / By 2025, 95% of PLHIV benefit from quality care and treatment services. D’ici 2025, 50% des PVVIH sous ARV ont une charge virale VIH supprimée / By 2025, 50% of PLHIV on ART have a suppressed viral load. D’ici 2025, 60% des PVVIH jouissent tous de leurs droits à travers la protection et la promotion des droits humains / By 2025, 60% of PLHIV enjoy their rights through the protection and promotion of human rights

Percentage of men who have sex with men that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of sex workers that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Percentage of men who have sex with men reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of sex workers reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of HIV-positive results among the total HIV tests performed during the reporting period
Percentage of HIV-positive women who received ART during pregnancy and/or labour and delivery
Number of adolescent girls and young women who were tested for HIV and received their results during the reporting period
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of people on ART among all people living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of PLHIV on ART who initiated TB preventive therapy among those eligible during the reporting period
Percentage of people living with HIV newly initiated on ART who were screened for TB
Completeness of facility reporting: Percentage of expected facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received

Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of health facilities with tracer medicines for the three diseases available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment

TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population

Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
